The '''Quilan Pyradex''' was a type of artifact. Shaped like an inscribed [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] pyramid and originating in the [[Quilan system/Legends|Quilan system]], it assisted with mental mathematical computations. By [[3638 BBY]], the Quilan Pyradexes were very rare, although one such item was recovered that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Nearly [[85 BBY/Legends|four millennia]] later, a Quilan Pyradex had become a part of the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Shiin]]'s private collection on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Description==
The Quilan Pyradex was a type of artifact<ref name="Solving the Equation">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Solving the Equation}}</ref> originating in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Quilan system/Legends|Quilan system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Roche sector/Legends|Roche sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Made out of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] and shaped like a pyramid with inscribed digits on its surface, the artifacts radiated inner light that highlighted several of the symbols. The Quilan Pyradexes assisted those holding them with carrying out extensive mathematical computations in their heads, although the devices were more attuned to [[Hive mind/Legends|hive-minded]] [[Species/Legends|species]] than others.<ref name="Gamer7" />

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel}}
By [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="TORdate" /> only a handful of Quilan Pyradexes had been discovered. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] recovered one of the artifacts. They subsequently tasked a companion with investigating the mysterious origin of the item, a process that eventually involved solving an equation.<ref name="Solving the Equation" />
{{Endgame}}

At some point by [[85 BBY/Legends|85 BBY]],<ref name="date">{{GamerCite|7|Secrets of Mos Eisley}} states that a Quilan Pyradex was held in [[Shiin's Library]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], the latter of which was established in [[85 BBY/Legends|85 BBY]] per ''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''.</ref> a Quilan Pyradex had become one of the more esoteric items in the private collection of the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Shiin]], which [[Gender/Legends|she]] held in a [[Shiin's Library|library]] in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] on<ref name="Gamer7" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. All of the artifacts in Shiin's [[Library/Legends|library]], including the Quilan Pyradex, had been imaged and logged into the local [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system before being locked in an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] vault.<ref name="Gamer7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Quilan Pyradex was first mentioned in the [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' source article "[[Secrets of Mos Eisley]]," which was authored by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 7|seventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Gamer7" /> on [[October 16]], [[2001]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20011018.html|text=Live on the Fringe: ''Gamer'' # 7}}</ref>
